protocol: PART 0C / PART 1 emission-site map: each hard cut-off and its soft replacement

hard_cutoffs.name: top-k cap
hard_cutoffs.soft_replacement: unchanged (cap stays; it bounds the candidate set, not a pass/fail)

hard_cutoffs.name: threshold
hard_cutoffs.rule: norm_sig >= threshold -> pass else drop (HARD CLIFF)
hard_cutoffs.soft_replacement: FE_SOFT_CHANNEL_GATE: graded weight via _soft_gate_weight over band [threshold-band, threshold+band]; just-below keeps noise_floor; weight stored in EdgeParams.confidence and edge signal

hard_cutoffs.name: signal normalization
hard_cutoffs.rule: divide by the MAXIMUM candidate signal
hard_cutoffs.soft_replacement: divide by q0.95 percentile (FE_SOFT_GATE_PERCENTILE) so one outlier does not compress the rest

hard_cutoffs.name: reach
hard_cutoffs.soft_replacement: reach graded over [0, reach], small weight up to reach*(1+band)

hard_cutoffs.name: mutual-best
hard_cutoffs.soft_replacement: graded mutual = d(v,nearest[v]) / d(v,u); near-mutual keeps small weight

hard_cutoffs.name: corner turn
hard_cutoffs.soft_replacement: graded turn_strength over a band below the threshold (_graded_ratio)

hard_cutoffs.name: occlusion gap
hard_cutoffs.soft_replacement: graded gap strength; small weight beyond

hard_cutoffs.name: dedup radius
hard_cutoffs.rule: close corners merged, keep highest-turn, DELETE others
hard_cutoffs.soft_replacement: merge keep-larger-weight: cluster by position, keep highest-WEIGHT site (never delete)

l4_junctions.part1b_corner_localisation: corner position localised at the line-intersection of the two straight arms through neighbouring peaks (_corner_localise); falls back to the peak when arms are degenerate/far

l6_address.note: no edge emission; computes addresses. Vector address (PART 2) beside the WL hash; hash stays canonical ID (NAME), vector is the graded MATCH replacement.

lens_channels.note: each funnels through _process_channel -> _channel_process; the single soft gate covers all of them. No per-channel hard cut-offs beyond the shared threshold/cap.
